system.description: You channel energy into an object (like a melee or ranged weapon). Until you use a one-hour or longer recovery, any attack you make with the energized object inflicts an additional 1 damage from energy (if the weapon fires projectiles, such as bullets from a rifle, this damage applies to the projectiles). The energy drains out if you stop holding or carrying the object, but as an extra action on your turn, you can energize a different object. Action. When you energize an object, you use psychokinetic energy, which tends to give affected weapons a subtle purple glimmer.
